QuestInfo.name: Another Method
QuestInfo.0: You wonder if #p2153003# went into the Mine to rescue #p2154004#. Go to the #b#m310040200##k one more time.
QuestInfo.1: It seems like he used the Rock Shield to enter, but failed to get past the gatekeeper. #p2153003# is still looking for a way to enter the Mine. According to the rumors, there is someone who sells #bhats that can disguise people as Black Wings#k. Find a #t1003134# for #p2153003#.\n\n#i1003134# #t1003134# #b#c1003134# / 1#k
QuestInfo.2: When #p2153003# received the #t1003134#, he said he'll sneak into the Hideout and bring #p2154004# with him. Then, in the cockiest way possible, he said to prepare a welcome party for his return.

0.0: Ugh, I'm sorry. Despite your help, I couldn't get into the mine. The Rock Shield worked, but the gatekeeper was too strong. That darn rabbit!
0.1: I haven't given up yet though! I will enter the mine somehow and rescue poor #p2154004#! I've already devised a new plan. You'll join me, right?

yes.0: According to rumors, someone around here sells #b#t1003134##ks. If we wear them, the Black Wings will let us in. So please go get some #t1003134#s for both of us. I'm counting on you, friend!

no.0: I won't let one failure get to me. I know that you must be disappointed but let's try again!

1.0: Did you get the #t1003134#? Is this it? Yes, this dark color is just like what the Black Wings wear. Okay, let's wear this and sneak into the mine. Then I'm going to rescue #p2154004#! #p2153003# is on the way!

yes.0: Who is selling these hats anyway? What? #p2153000#, the watchman? I haven't seen him in town for awhile...so this is what he's been up to after joining the Black Wings. You probably don't know but #p2153000# was always known in town as a coward.

item.0: You haven't obtained the #b#t1003134#s#k yet? #bSomeone#k around here is definitely selling it. He's supposed to be #baround here#k.
